question: Who among the following personalities has been awarded the Gandhi Peace Prize in 2018 for his/her contribution to leprosy eradication?
solution:
The correct option is __**Yohei Sasakawa.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• He is the chairman of** The Nippon Foundation, the World Health Organization Goodwill Ambassador for Leprosy Elimination.**
 
• He is **Japan's Ambassador** for the **Human Rights of People Affected by leprosy**.
 
• He was awarded **2017 Gandhi Peace Prize** for his contributions towards leprosy eradication in India.
 
• He launched the **"Seabed 2030"**, an initiative to map the world's ocean floor by the year 2030.
 
• He also won** 2006 International Gandhi Award**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jane Addams**

 
 
• **​Laura Jane Addams** was born on **September 6, 1860 and died on May 21, 1935**.
 
• She was an American settlement activist, reformer, social worker, sociologist, public administrator and author.
 
• In** 1931**, she became the **first American woman to be awarded the Nobel Peace Prize.**
 
 
 
• **Harriet Tubman**
 
 
• ​Harriet Tubman was an American abolitionist and social activist lived from** March, 1822 to March, 1913**.
 
• She was also known as '**Minty' or 'Moses'**.
 
• She is known for **'freeing enslaved people**' from slavery.
 
 
 
• **Nelson Mandela**
 
 
• **​Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela** (**18 July 1918 – 5 December 2013**) was a South African anti-apartheid activist.
 
• He was the **1st President of South Africa** from **1994 to 1999.**
 
• He is also known as the **"Gandhi of South Africa"**.
